definitions: To make something neater or more even by cutting a small amount from it.
To reduce the size, amount, or extent of something.
To decorate something, especially with ribbon or other adornments.
To adjust the balance of a ship or aircraft by shifting its cargo or by adjusting its control surfaces.
examples: She asked the hairdresser to trim her fringe.
The company had to trim its budget.
The dress was trimmed with lace.
The pilot trimmed the aircraft for level flight.
